subject: Minor issue with the meeting room setup
text:
The heating in the smaller meeting room stopped working this morning. It seems to be the same side as last month, so it may need a technician rather than a quick reset. It is not urgent, but the room feels noticeably cooler near the back tables.

The event itself is still proceeding, but we would like it checked before the next session begins. A practical fix would be preferable, even if it means a portable heater or a temporary replacement unit. That would help the afternoon participants stay comfortable during the short breaks.

Please let me know what time window works best. I can arrange access to the side entrance without disturbing the other scheduled groups. A simple solution would be enough.
